mapper.sql: SELECT base.tenant_id AS tenantId, base.dept_id AS deptId, COALESCE(dept.dept_name, snap.dept_name) AS deptName, base.product_id AS productId, prod.product_code AS productCode, COALESCE(prod.product_name, snap.product_name) AS productName, prod.unit AS unit, prod.min_stock AS minStock, COALESCE(snap.quantity, led_open.opening_quantity, 0) AS openingQuantity, COALESCE(rng.purchase_net_in, 0) AS purchaseNetInQuantity, COALESCE(rng.sale_net_out, 0) AS saleNetOutQuantity, COALESCE(rng.other_adjustment_net, 0) AS otherAdjustmentNetQuantity, COALESCE(snap.quantity, led_open.opening_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(rng.purchase_net_in, 0) - COALESCE(rng.sale_net_out, 0) + COALESCE(rng.other_adjustment_net, 0) AS closingQuantity, rng.last_inbound_time AS lastInboundTime, rng.last_outbound_time AS lastOutboundTime, CASE WHEN rng.last_outbound_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(#{query.endDate}, rng.last_outbound_time) END AS daysWithoutSale, CASE WHEN COALESCE(snap.quantity, led_open.opening_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(rng.purchase_net_in, 0) - COALESCE(rng.sale_net_out, 0) + COALESCE(rng.other_adjustment_net, 0) < 0 THEN 'NEGATIVE_STOCK' WHEN COALESCE(snap.quantity, led_open.opening_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(rng.purchase_net_in, 0) - COALESCE(rng.sale_net_out, 0) + COALESCE(rng.other_adjustment_net, 0) = 0 THEN 'ZERO_STOCK' WHEN prod.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(snap.quantity, led_open.opening_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(rng.purchase_net_in, 0) - COALESCE(rng.sale_net_out, 0) + COALESCE(rng.other_adjustment_net, 0) < prod.min_stock THEN 'LOW_STOCK' WHEN rng.last_outbound_time IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(#{query.endDate}, rng.last_outbound_time) > 30 THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS stockStatus, CASE WHEN snap_end.end_snapshot_quantity IS NOT NULL AND snap_end.end_snapshot_quantity <> COALESCE(snap.quantity, led_open.opening_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(rng.purchase_net_in, 0) - COALESCE(rng.sale_net_out, 0) + COALESCE(rng.other_adjustment_net, 0) THEN 'ANOMALY' ELSE 'OK' END AS reconciliationStatus FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, dept_id, product_id FROM fin_stock_ledger WHERE AND del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, dept_id, product_id FROM fin_stock_snapshot WHERE ) base LEFT JOIN fin_product prod ON prod.product_id = base.product_id AND prod.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = base.dept_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.tenant_id, s.dept_id, s.product_id, s.quantity, s.dept_name, s.product_name FROM fin_stock_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_date FROM fin_stock_snapshot WHERE AND snapshot_date < #{query.startDate} GROUP BY tenant_id, dept_id, product_id ) lm ON lm.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND lm.dept_id = s.dept_id AND lm.product_id = s.product_id AND lm.max_date = s.snapshot_date WHERE AND s.snapshot_date < #{query.startDate} ) snap ON snap.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND snap.dept_id = base.dept_id AND snap.product_id = base.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, COALESCE(SUM(change_quantity), 0) AS opening_quantity FROM fin_stock_ledger WHERE AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time < #{query.startDate} GROUP BY tenant_id, dept_id, product_id ) led_open ON led_open.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND led_open.dept_id = base.dept_id AND led_open.product_id = base.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, SUM(CASE change_type WHEN 'PURCHASE_IN' THEN change_quantity WHEN 'PURCHASE_REVERSE' THEN change_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_net_in, SUM(CASE change_type WHEN 'SALE_OUT' THEN -change_quantity WHEN 'SALE_REVERSE' THEN -change_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS sale_net_out, SUM(CASE change_type WHEN 'STOCK_TAKE_GAIN' THEN change_quantity WHEN 'STOCK_TAKE_LOSS' THEN change_quantity WHEN 'STOCK_TAKE_REVERSE' THEN change_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS other_adjustment_net, MAX(CASE WHEN change_type IN ('PURCHASE_IN','SALE_REVERSE') THEN create_time END) AS last_inbound_time, MAX(CASE WHEN change_type IN ('SALE_OUT','PURCHASE_REVERSE') THEN create_time END) AS last_outbound_time FROM fin_stock_ledger WHERE AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{query.startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY tenant_id, dept_id, product_id ) rng ON rng.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND rng.dept_id = base.dept_id AND rng.product_id = base.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, quantity AS end_snapshot_quantity FROM fin_stock_snapshot WHERE AND snapshot_date = #{query.endDate} ) snap_end ON snap_end.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND snap_end.dept_id = base.dept_id AND snap_end.product_id = base.product_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.openingQuantity), 0) AS openingQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(p.purchaseNetInQuantity), 0) AS purchaseNetInQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(p.saleNetOutQuantity), 0) AS saleNetOutQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(p.otherAdjustmentNetQuantity), 0) AS otherAdjustmentNetQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(p.closingQuantity), 0) AS closingQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN p.stockStatus = 'NEGATIVE_STOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negativeStockCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.stockStatus = 'LOW_STOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowStockCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.stockStatus = 'ZERO_STOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zeroStockCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.stockStatus = 'STALE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staleStockCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.reconciliationStatus = 'ANOMALY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anomalyCount FROM (
) p

SELECT ledger_id AS ledgerId, tenant_id AS tenantId, dept_id AS deptId, product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, change_type AS changeType, change_quantity AS changeQuantity, before_quantity AS beforeQuantity, after_quantity AS afterQuantity, reference_type AS referenceType, reference_id AS referenceId, reference_no AS referenceNo, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, remark FROM fin_stock_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY create_time ASC, ledger_id ASC

SELECT opening.opening_amount AS openingAmount, rng.inbound_amount AS inboundAmount, rng.sale_cost AS saleCost, rng.adjustment_amount AS adjustmentAmount, (opening.opening_amount + rng.inbound_amount - rng.sale_cost + rng.adjustment_amount) AS closingAmount, revenue.sale_revenue AS saleRevenue FROM (SELECT 1) dummy LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE cost_change_type WHEN 'COST_IN' THEN amount WHEN 'COST_REVERSE_IN' THEN amount WHEN 'COST_OUT' THEN -amount WHEN 'COST_REVERSE_OUT' THEN -amount WHEN 'COST_ADJUST' THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS opening_amount FROM fin_stock_cost_ledger WHERE AND create_time < #{query.startDate} ) opening ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_change_type = 'COST_IN' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_change_type = 'COST_REVERSE_OUT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inbound_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_change_type = 'COST_OUT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_change_type = 'COST_REVERSE_IN' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sale_cost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_change_type = 'COST_ADJUST' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS adjustment_amount FROM fin_stock_cost_ledger WHERE AND create_time >= #{query.startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) rng ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sale_amount), 0) AS sale_revenue FROM fin_sale_record WHERE AND sale_date >= #{query.startDate} AND sale_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) revenue ON 1 = 1

AND l.dept_id IN
#{deptId}
